HTTP clients make REST calls to PUBLIC_API (FastAPI); web (Next.js 14) makes REST calls to INTERACTION (Flask).
INTERACTION (Flask) long-polls SQS and reads + writes PostgreSQL; PUBLIC_API (FastAPI) reads PostgreSQL.
